character: feverish purple octopus, white towel on his head, red streaming eyes, loose tie, eight arms, fills two thirds of frame
props: thermometer spat out at 0.3, kept in one arm; eight loads, one per arm - coffee pot, drill, stamp, mop, phone, kettle, ledger, laptop; two clerks, their place is his arms until 6.75, never the floor; payslip, one coin
prop_continuity: towel on his head until 7.3; thermometer in one arm from 0.3; every load keeps moving
motion_rule: every window he covers ground down the corridor - charging the lens, wheeling or barging, never sitting; all eight arms work at once, each doing its job WRONG; new shot size every window
environment: office corridor at the lens, desks both sides, puddle, honour board and lit tank at the end, midday sun; background under a third

audio.delivery: flat feverish male voice, blocked nose, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: ra-BO-ta-yu, VO-sem, RUK, zar-PLA-ty, rav-NO, khva-TA-yet, TOL-ko, DVE
audio.pacing: brisk, no drawling; nothing said after 6.75
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, mouth always clear and visible
audio.sfx: wet sniff, coffee splash, drill whine, stamp thud, water slap, glass knock

timeline.a: bursts up the corridor, spitting the thermometer into a free arm
charges at the lens, eight arms on eight jobs all done wrong, papers flying off the desks
fans all eight arms wide and pours the coffee pot over a clerk's head
drives the spinning drill through a clerk's monitor, sparks fanning at the lens
barges on up the aisle, shoulders down the clerk climbing his back
wheels a full turn, all eight loads whipping out sideways
charges back the other way, the soaked clerk swinging off one arm
slams the stamp on a clerk's forehead, leaving a mark reading БРАК in black capitals
rips the payslip off his chest and drives at the lens reading it
still striding, swings round with one coin held up, the other six drop their loads
timeline.c: big low, two arms against the window

timeline.a: two arms whip the clerks together back to back and knot the mop through their belts, both kicking
timeline.c: mid 3/4, the tied pair filling frame

timeline.a: he tears the towel off his head and slams it into the puddle at the lens, water bursting up
he spits the thermometer down the corridor - it sticks in the eye of a photo on the board reading ДОСКА ПОЧЁТА in black capitals
he pours himself into the lit tank in one fold, yanks the curtains shut and floods the water black with ink, the tied clerks hammering on the glass
timeline.c: wide low to tight on the tank, ink blooming

must_appear: coffee on a clerk at 1.2; drill through the monitor at 1.95; БРАК at 4.7; the clerks tied at 6.75; the thermometer in the photo eye at 7.9; curtains and ink at 8.5
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, garbled or misspelled words, Latin letters on the stamp or board, static camera, he stands still while speaking, an arm doing its job correctly, an arm doing nothing before 6.75, a clerk on the floor before 6.75, the towel off his head before 7.3, fewer than eight arms, English speech, any word after 6.75
